posts.topic: Creator call: Hampton Roads founding roster
posts.text:
Hampton Roads creators: the founding roster is open.

Magpie connects local creators with local businesses: they comp your visit, you post honestly within 48 hours (1 post or reel plus 1 story that shares it, disclosed, your own words), and we track the results.

Comped visits are the everyday lane. The paid lane sits on top: list your own rate for direct paid bookings, keep 97 percent, payment released when your post is live. Comp-only is always fine.

Magpie is free for creators. Always. Businesses pay the platform. You never pay to join, to list, or to get booked.

To claim: comment your handle and your city (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Hampton, Newport News, Suffolk, Portsmouth, Williamsburg) and we reply with your personal claim link. The claim link is in our bio.

500 followers is enough to start. Neighbors 500 to 2,000. Locals 2,000 to 15,000. Headliners 15,000+.

National platforms sell reach. We sell regulars. #HamptonRoads #757 #LocalCreators #CreatorEconomy
